label: Features
heading: Everything You Need to
subheading: A complete AI sales execution stack — not just another CRM with a chatbot bolted on.

items.title: AI Voice Agent
items.description: Autonomous outbound and inbound calling that qualifies leads, handles objections, and books meetings on your calendar.

items.title: Hybrid Calling System
items.description: Seamlessly switch between AI and human agents. Your reps pick up exactly where AI left off.

items.title: WhatsApp API Automation
items.description: Send templated messages, trigger reminders, and manage conversations directly from your pipeline.

items.title: Email Sequences
items.description: Drip campaigns that adapt based on lead behavior. AI writes, sends, and optimizes your outreach.

items.title: Visual Pipeline
items.description: Drag-and-drop deal management with AI-powered stage predictions and win probability scoring.

items.title: Custom Workflow Builder
items.description: No-code automation builder. Create complex multi-step workflows with conditional logic and triggers.

items.title: Custom Reports
items.description: Build reports tailored to your KPIs. Track conversion rates, rep performance, and revenue metrics your way.

items.title: Enterprise Security
items.description: SOC2-ready infrastructure with role-based access, audit logs, and data encryption at rest and in transit.
